# Acme Widget Pro (fixture site for ai-readable)

> A demo site with one deliberately broken page per failure class.

- [Buying guide](https://citlyze.github.io/ai-readable/fixture/): passes every check
- [Pricing](https://citlyze.github.io/ai-readable/fixture/pricing/): client-rendered, invisible to crawlers that skip JavaScript
- [Blocked docs](https://citlyze.github.io/ai-readable/fixture/blocked/): OAI-SearchBot disallowed in robots.txt
- [Noindex](https://citlyze.github.io/ai-readable/fixture/noindex/): noindex leaked from staging
